{{Top|leg}}
The '''memory upgrade''' provided additional memory banks and computing power in a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. This upgrade was integrated into existing programing without any conflicts.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
